component.title: Menu
component.purpose: Expose contextual commands with dependable keyboard and pointer semantics.

states.description: Open menu with command, checkbox, radio, separator, disabled, and shortcut items.
The menu opens, moves focus, and dismisses while restoring the trigger.

claims.statement: Roving focus, Home/End, typeahead, Escape, and semantic item roles are wired through the menu surface.
The anchored surface maintains contrast and focus visibility in dark kits.
